relation: SL < Linf  (a von Bertalanffy grower never reaches its own asymptotic length)
note: Checks a design's standard length against the asymptotic length of the growth curve fitted to its OWN species, looked up in development/growth.json. 'violated' means the design's length is impossible under that fitted curve; it does NOT mean the animal cannot be that long, because only 7 of 75 Exocoetidae species have a growth row, only 2 of those have fork-length rows, and all 12 rows are a FishBase compilation (kind 'secondary') fitted in one locality and year. select is 'max': where a species has several published fits the LOOSEST asymptote is used, so that a red verdict never depends on which of three fits a reader believes - the conservative direction for a law whose job is to rule designs out. fallback_key is null on purpose: a species with no fork-length row gets cannot-evaluate rather than being judged against another species' asymptote. The scale 0.00927 converts cm FL to m SL and is the weakest number in this row.
